name: Locolourtor
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: geek
description: Locolourtor is a client-side mod that lets you customise the colour of your marker on Minecraft's locator bar. Your chosen colour syncs in real-time to any other players with Locolourtor installed, no need for any server-side mods.
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Code next to data (0.3)
